@prefix rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix : <http://www.example.org/ontology#> .

:EDIFACTInvoiceOntology rdf:type owl:Ontology ;
  rdfs:label "EDIFACT D96A INVOIC and P2P-O Ontology" ;
  rdfs:comment "A profoundly structured ontology for digital business documents based on UN/EDIFACT D96A, EANCOM INVOIC, and P2P-O, including all mandatory segments, roles, and constraints for semantic interoperability." .

#################################################################
# Classes (as before, with naming harmonized)
#################################################################

:InterchangeEnvelope rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Interchange Envelope" ; rdfs:comment "The top-level envelope containing EDIFACT messages." .
:Message rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Message" ; rdfs:comment "A business document contained within an Interchange Envelope." .
:InvoiceMessage rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf :Message ; rdfs:label "Invoice Message" ; rdfs:comment "An INVOIC message representing a global trade transaction." .
:Segment rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Segment" ; rdfs:comment "A segment within a message, composed of composite and simple data elements." .
:BgmSegment rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment ; rdfs:label "BGM Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Beginning of Message segment for document identification." .
:NadSegment rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment ; rdfs:label "NAD Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Name and Address segment for participant details." .
:DtmSegment rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment ; rdfs:label "DTM Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Date/Time/Period segment for document dates." .
:RffSegment rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment ; rdfs:label "RFF Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Reference segment for reference numbers." .
:CuxSegment rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment ; rdfs:label "CUX Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Currency segment for currency codes." .
:PatSegment rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment ; rdfs:label "PAT Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Payment Terms segment for payment conditions." .
:AlcSegment rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment ; rdfs:label "ALC Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Allowances and Charges segment." .
:TaxSegment rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment ; rdfs:label "TAX Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Tax segment for tax details." .
:MoaSegment rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment ; rdfs:label "MOA Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Monetary Amount segment." .
:QtySegment rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment ; rdfs:label "QTY Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Quantity segment." .
:PriSegment rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment ; rdfs:label "PRI Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Price segment for price details." .
:LinSegment rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment ; rdfs:label "LIN Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Line Item segment." .
:PiaSegment rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment ; rdfs:label "PIA Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Additional Product ID segment." .
:ImdSegment rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment ; rdfs:label "IMD Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Item Description segment." .
:LocSegment rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment ; rdfs:label "LOC Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Location segment." .
:TdtSegment rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf :Segment ; rdfs:label "TDT Segment" ; rdfs:comment "Transport segment for transport details." .
:CompositeDataElement rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Composite Data Element" ; rdfs:comment "A composite data element within a segment." .
:SimpleDataElement rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Simple Data Element" ; rdfs:comment "A simple data element within a composite data element." .
:Organization rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Organization" ; rdfs:comment "A party involved in the invoice, such as Buyer or Supplier." .
:Agentrole rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Agent Role" ; rdfs:comment "A role played by an organization within an invoice." .
:Address rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Address" ; rdfs:comment "Address information for an organization." .
:Identifier rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Identifier" ; rdfs:comment "An identifier for an organization, such as a Global Location Number." .
:GlobalLocationNumber rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Global Location Number" ; rdfs:comment "A global location identifier for organizations." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Identifier .
:InvoiceHeader rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf :CompositeDataElement ; rdfs:label "Invoice Header" ; rdfs:comment "Header section of the invoice message." .
:InvoiceDetail rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf :CompositeDataElement ; rdfs:label "Invoice Detail" ; rdfs:comment "Detail section of the invoice message, listing line items." .
:InvoiceSummary rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf :CompositeDataElement ; rdfs:label "Invoice Summary" ; rdfs:comment "Summary section of the invoice message, providing totals." .
:LineItem rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf :CompositeDataElement ; rdfs:label "Line Item" ; rdfs:comment "An itemized entry in the invoice detail section." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Price, :Amount, :ReferenceNumber .
:Item rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Item" ; rdfs:comment "A product or service sold in the invoice." .
:Price rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Price" ; rdfs:comment "Price information for an item." ; rdfs:subClassOf :CompositeDataElement .
:Tax rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Tax" ; rdfs:comment "Tax information for the invoice." .
:Amount rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Amount" ; rdfs:comment "Amount information for the invoice." ; rdfs:subClassOf :CompositeDataElement .
:ReferenceNumber rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Reference Number" ; rdfs:comment "Reference number for the invoice." ; rdfs:subClassOf :CompositeDataElement .
:BusinessProcess rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Business Process" ; rdfs:comment "A business process associated with the invoice." .
:ValidationConstraint rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Validation Constraint" ; rdfs:comment "A constraint used for validating invoice data." .
:SHACLConstraint rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "SHACL Constraint" ; rdfs:comment "A SHACL constraint for automated validation." .
:PurchaseToPayOntologyEntity rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf owl:Thing ; rdfs:label "Purchase-to-Pay Ontology Entity" ; rdfs:comment "Entity from the Purchase-to-Pay Ontology for semantic alignment." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Organization, :Item .

#################################################################
# Pivot Classes
#################################################################

:OrganizationRoleAssignment rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Organization Role Assignment" ; rdfs:comment "Reification class linking an organization to a specific role, address, and identifier in the invoice context." .
:InvoiceItemization rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Invoice Itemization" ; rdfs:comment "Reification class linking invoice message to itemized line items." .

refinement_plan_1:
Analysis of Review Feedback (Iteration 1):

1. HIGH PRIORITY SUGGESTIONS:
  - Add explicit properties and classes for all mandatory D96A fields and EN 16931-1 requirements (e.g., tax identifiers, document references, payment terms) as datatype properties with cardinality restrictions. This will improve CQ5 (organization info) and CQ13 (mandatory fields/validation).
  - Ensure every class and property has rdfs:label and rdfs:comment (annotation completeness). Some are missing, especially properties and some classes.

2. MEDIUM PRIORITY SUGGESTIONS:
  - Add disjointness axioms between major classes (e.g., Segment, CompositeElement, SimpleElement, OrganizationRole) and between role types to prevent unintended overlaps.
  - Add General Class Axioms (GCAs) to define, e.g., that an Invoice with a buyer and seller is an 'EDIFACTInvoice', or that a Message containing only INVOIC segments is an 'InvoiceMessage'.

3. LOW PRIORITY SUGGESTIONS:
  - Model business process assignment explicitly (link Invoice to a BusinessProcess class/instance) for CQ14.

4. CONSTRAINTS TO FIX:
  - Missing rdfs:label and rdfs:comment on several properties/classes.
  - Not all mandatory data properties are explicitly marked as required (missing owl:cardinality or owl:minCardinality restrictions).
  - Some composite/pivot classes lack explicit disjointness.

5. CQs TO IMPROVE:
  - CQ5: Add more organization attributes (contacts, tax IDs, etc.).
  - CQ13: Add all mandatory D96A/EN 16931-1 fields and SHACL validation constraint stubs.
  - CQ14: Add explicit business process assignment property/class.

6. SPECIFIC CHANGES TO MAKE:
  - Add datatype properties for organization contact, tax ID, VAT ID, etc. Add cardinality restrictions for required fields.
  - Add missing rdfs:label and rdfs:comment to all classes and properties.
  - Add owl:disjointWith axioms for major classes and role types.
  - Add GCAs (equivalentClass axioms) for InvoiceMessage and EDIFACTInvoice.
  - Add explicit :hasBusinessProcess property and ensure InvoiceMessage is linked.
  - Add SHACLConstraint/ValidationConstraint stubs for file format validity.

Plan: Tackle HIGH priority fixes first (mandatory fields, annotations), then add disjointness and GCAs, finally address business process assignment. Validate after each major change.
